frequency_question: What proportion of nominated principal executive officers obtain confirmed floor votes when backed by executive intent within a short term window?
membership_rule: Members are all formally nominated cabinet secretaries and major agency heads (FDA, EPA, CDC, etc.) submitted to the U.S. Senate where the executive branch actively pushes for confirmation within a comparable time frame. Excluded are lower-level sub-cabinet posts without active floor prioritization.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named high-profile health principal nominations; 100% confirmation success rate when prioritized by the executive.
known_gaps: Excludes withdrawn nominations where executive intent was deliberately withdrawn prior to vote.
skeleton: 5 executive health agency nominations tracked across recent administrations where executive will was absolute.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to the dynamics of executive-legislative confirmation norms which remain stable within standard presidential terms.
